 England vs Croatia LIVE: Nations League latest score, match stream, goal updates
 Harry Kane to become record appearance-maker for men’s team 
 England vs Croatia LIVE Getty Alex Young , Senior Sport Editor @ alexwsyoung | Dom Smith , Football Reporter @ MrDomSmith | Sam Tabuteau , Sports Reporter 2 minutes ago England vs Croatia LIVE
 All eyes will be on Harry Kane tonight as England host Croatia in their penultimate Nations League game. The Three Lions skipper tonight makes history as the record appearance-maker for the men’s senior team, with his 126th cap . He overtakes Peter Shilton, whose final game for England came at the 1990 World Cup.
 It is yet another staggering achievement for Kane, who has already shattered the goal record with 91 strikes to date, which is 38 more than previous holder Wayne Rooney. Kane also tonight leads his country out as captain for the 98th time, which is eight more than Billy Wright and Bobby Moore.

 Modric is on for Croatia, replacing Misic.
